cutover.method: pg_restore into fresh PostgreSQL 17 database (logical dump/restore; pg_upgrade not used in this rehearsal)

post_upgrade_verify.post_cutover_data_loss_note: Writes after cutover to PG17 (e.g. post-cutover-write line in data/) are NOT in the PG16-era dump; rollback restores DB to pre-cutover instant only — reconcile or lose post-cutover filesystem deltas.

rollback.method: restore PRE-cutover PG16 dump into fresh PG16 database (NOT a PG17 dump)

unsupported.pg17_dump_restore_to_pg16: pg_restore: error: unsupported version (1.16) in file header
unsupported.schema_major_downgrade: restore-only via pre-cutover backup; never import PG17 logical dump into PG16

go_toolchain_note: Go 1.26→1.27 is a compiler/runtime bump (redeploy prior binary); persistent irreversibility applies to PostgreSQL major state after cutover without a matching-era backup.
